title: lathyrus stipulaceus var. incanus
intro: Lathyrus stipulaceus var. incanus, commonly known as the hairy pea, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus stipulaceus var. incanus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective activities. However, further research is needed to fully elucidate the therapeutic potential of this plant, and its safety and efficacy should be evaluated in well-designed clinical trials.
